text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Damn it! Damn it all straight to
hell!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... So that's the dream that's gonna kick off the new year, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, not much I can do about it. Guess
I'll collate
some data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Two minutes and two seconds flat, two
minutes
and 1.3 seconds, two minutes
and 0.7 seconds...
That's enough data
for firm surface conditions.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I need a little more data on soft and
good
surfaces. I'll need to put in a
request to use the
sprinklers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Am I gonna make it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I need a walk.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
...Three, two, one!
Happy New Yeaaar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been so busy preparing for Shakur's
classic
year, the new year crept up on
me before I
realized it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I leave the academy
for a
midnight stroll... only to spot the
shadowy outline
of a student also trying
to leave. And not just any
student...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy has a curfew, and any
student
caught breaking it will be in
deep trouble. No
excuse will hold water
if she leaves the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just going for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know. And?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I just weigh the pros and cons.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not like anyone is watchin' right now.
If you
just look the other way,
everything's settled.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, I've wasted enough time talking to
you. Go
away already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her classic year finally upon us, it's
possible
she's feeling a bit tense.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear what I said? You're
bothering me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curfew is in place to protect the
students. As
much as I don't want to
restrict Air Shakur, I can't
look the other
way on this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to delay her until she gets her
feelings
under control. If I'm going to
get her to agree, I
need to show her its
in her best interest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
What kinda deal?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No deal then. There's nothin' I want from
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Negotiations over. Later.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna make a deal, then bring
something
to the table.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, there's no point in me pullin'
up a
chair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's absolutely right. What do I have to
offer
that might make for a good deal?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur seems to want to go
somewhere quiet
right now. Not only is
my office free at this hour,
there's hardly
anyone on campus outside of the
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What about the security guards?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And you're gonna stay outta my way,
right?
You're not plannin' on monitoring
me or anything
like that, are you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well... as long as you really won't be
there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to monitor her. All the
same, I do
need to keep an eye on her,
just in case anything
happens. I'll give
her space, but stay just close
enough to
ensure she's safe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Figures. Sleepin' on the job.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Idiot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is gone when I wake up the
next
morning, and the jacket I'd left in
my office is
draped over me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be because I'm too tired from
working
late, but I'm at a complete loss
as to what to do.
The only thing I can
manage to say is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, is that all you can say?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, wait. You look like...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur stares at me long and hard.
After some
time...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'm gonna hit the sack.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You should hurry back and get some
sleep too.
Also...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Working longer doesn't mean you're
working
harder. If things aren't getting
done, you need to
reevaluate either
your workload or your methods.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The second you convince yourself you're
doin'
your best, it's over. Stop before
you hit that wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She appears to have seen right through
me. I
agree to get some sleep as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Someone's full of energy today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you embarrassed thanking me for

somethin' like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Meh, whatever. Let's hurry up and train.
Time
waits for no one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'll need to think this through
carefully.
Air Shakur is someone who
finds the absence of
data as informative
as data itself. In which case...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You're okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You realize that whatever happens is
your
responsibility now that you've seen
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Okay, if you say so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hold back the urge to stop her, and
watch as Air
Shakur walks away from me.
Just five more
steps... Four, three, two,
one...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, spit it out. What are you
scheming?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've been duped, huh? You weren't
actually
scheming anything, I bet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. Whatever. I'm not in the mood
anymore, so
I'm headin' back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bought a bunch of new snacks from a
local
convenience store to help get me
through my
overtime. I give them all to
her, in case there's
anything she likes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't need all this cra—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Does that one come with a toy from
LF? I
didn't realize that game was so
popular.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wow. I'm impressed with the level of
detail.
Maybe I could put it on my desk?
